items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: I'm looking at Mandela Mandela coming over dressed like me

ctx.x: I agree with you 100% so all in all

like I'm saying to each his own but this Creole thing we will always have people like Lyle Saxon and all these other writers of note who will write about them and talk about them but like I said it all depends on who they're talking about what era of time what went on back in the 1840s 1830s and so forth before you get into the 1900s but today we got a lot of people who call themselves Creole we got an element of blacks out in California who call themselves Creoles and I think De Picayune did a story on it some…
